name: Jubilant Agri & Consumer Products Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2008, Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products Ltd manufactures and sells Performance Polymers and Chemicals, P&K Fertilizers, and Agri Nutrients[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
JACPL is a part of the Jubilant Bhartia group. 
 It is in the business of Performance Polymers 
 & Chemicals and Agri products for B2C & B2B

cons: Stock is trading at 8.61 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
